estado: proposta ate o portao de estilo; a v1 congela elevacao, escala, direcoes e acabamento
notas: Axes: map x points east (screen right) and map y points south (screen down); Blender x is east, y is north, z is up, and the camera looks north.
A ground offset of d cells shows as d*px horizontally and d*px*sin(elevation) vertically; a height of h metres shows h*(px/metrosPorCelula)*cos(elevation) up.

Height levels of the map (0..nivelMaximo) stand metrosPorNivel apart: one level rises about 0.7 cell on screen at 55 degrees, and the ground point under a pixel moves up to nivelMaximo*metrosPorNivel*cos/(metrosPorCelula*sin) cells north on a plateau.
Default zoom: px = canvasHeight / (colunasReferencia * 9/16), then clamped so the visible columns stay in [colunasMin, colunasMax]; the zoom factor multiplies the clamped value.
Blender ortho_scale = frameWidthPx / pxPorCelula[level] * metrosPorCelula (a 256 px uhd frame gives 8 m).
Sun azimuth is where the light comes from, counter-clockwise from east with north up; vetorParaOSol is in Blender axes.
Team tint: final = mix(colour, colour * teamColour * fator, mask); paint team areas neutral grey around sRGB cinzaNoPasseDeCor.
